author: screenrant
title: Dungeon Crawler Carl Expands into Multifaceted Franchise with New RPG and Upcoming TV Series
text:
The popular LitRPG series has grown from a modest 2020 debut into a full‑blown multimedia franchise that now includes an upcoming live‑action show on Peacock, a t‑shirt line, and a tabletop role‑playing game set for release in November 2026. The new RPG, created by Renegade Game Studios, is designed to let players step into the shoes of Carl and Princess Donut, while an exclusive dice set pays homage to the iconic Enchanted BigBoi Boxers. The series' author, Matt Dinniman, plans a two‑part conclusion to the saga, promising fans a final, emotionally resonant adventure.
Since its modest launch in 2020, the Dungeon Crawler Carl series has exploded into a cultural phenomenon, drawing millions of readers worldwide with Matt Dinniman's fresh spin on the LitRPG genre.
The story follows the eponymous protagonist, Carl, and his loyal companion, Princess Donut, as they navigate the perilous levels of the World Dungeon. With the most recent title, A Parade of Horribles, arriving in May, the series has now clocked eight books.
Readers eagerly await the bittersweet conclusion to Carl and Donut's epic journey, and the author has announced that the finale will be told in two parts, ensuring a satisfying wrap‑up that doesn't shy away from the series' darker moments. Not only has the literary franchise boomed, but it is also expanding into other media. A live‑action television adaptation will air on Peacock, bringing the Dungeon's unique blend of humor and horror to a wider audience.
The show will translate the books' distinctive tone and characters, allowing viewers to experience Carl's adventurous life in a new format. Meanwhile, merchandising is steadily growing, with an expanding lineup of products ranging from apparel to collectible figurines. These items cater to the devoted fan base that craves tangible connections to the beloved world.
Dungeon Crawler Carl Tabletop RPG And Dice Set
Perhaps the most exciting development for fans of tabletop gaming is the impending release of a Dungeon Crawler Carl tabletop RPG originally slated for launch in November 2026. Renegade Game Studios has announced that the game will faithfully reproduce the perilous, unpredictable feel of Borant's World Dungeon, complete with recognizable enemies, inventive loot boxes, and iconic locations.
The RPG will feature a comprehensive core rulebook, a starter set that focuses on the first two floors described in the inaugural book, as well as mod components that let players craft their own crawlers. In addition to the core game, the publisher is offering a Carl‑the‑Enchanted BigBoi Boxers Dice Set-a throwback to the lucky gear that has been integral to the series' lore.
The dice set is a seven‑component set of pearlescent white acrylic polyhedral dice with deep‑red detailing, ranging in size from a 1d4 to a 2d20, along with a two‑sided poker‑chip style die. Priced at $25, it is designed to be plug‑and‑play with the Dungeon Crawler Carl RPG, but its format also makes it compatible with a wide variety of other tabletop role‑playing systems.
The dice set is a nod to the iconic Enchanted BigBoi Boxers, which Carl first acquires after navigating the second floor of the dungeon. In the books, the enchanted underwear provides a +2 Constitution bonus and a protective shell spell, and gains additional upgrades as Carl ascends deeper levels. Collectors and gamers alike will appreciate that the dice set encapsulates this character‑defining item.
Dungeon Crawler Carl Cross Platform Franchise Strategy
The release of the RPG and dice set coincides with a broader strategy to solidify Dungeon Crawler Carl as a cross‑platform franchise. The pairing of a grounded literary series, a hit television adaptation, a range of merchandise, and a fully realized gaming experience exemplifies how modern media can build a cohesive ecosystem around a single narrative universe.
Fans can look forward to an immersive adventure whether they prefer to read about Carl's exploits, watch them unfold on screen, or run their own campaigns in dice‑pulling, role‑playing sessions where each decision can alter the course of the dungeon's treacherous descent. With the announcement of a two‑part final series, a live‑action show on Peacock, and a retail launch for an expansive tabletop RPG in November 2026, Dungeon Crawler Carl is set to cement its place as a multimedia juggernaut.
The franchise's blend of relatable protagonists, satirical humor, and vivid fantasy action continues to attract new audiences and furnish longtime fans with new ways to explore and celebrate the adventurous depths of the World Dungeon.
